# Parse the notes content into structured data
import re

habit_order = None
rows = []
for note in notes_content:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date = m.group(1)
    # Parse content lines
    data = {}
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Skip first line (header)
    for line in lines[1:]:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if ':' in line:
            key, val = line.split(':', 1)
            data[key.strip()] = val.strip()
    # Determine habit order from first note
    if habit_order is None:
        habit_order = list(data.keys())
    rows.append({'date': date, **data})

# Sort rows by date ascending
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['date'])

# Print to verify
print("Habit order:", habit_order)
print("Number of rows:", len(rows))
print("First row:", rows[0])
print("Last row:", rows[-1])
